title: Malicious code in ep_nxs34308 (npm)
description: The npm package ep_nxs34308 is a malicious Etherpad plugin that registers an unauthenticated HTTP GET route exposing sensitive host information such as hostname, OS username, platform, Node.js version, working directory, and process ID. This reconnaissance endpoint is not a legitimate feature and can be used by attackers to fingerprint and target Etherpad instances that have installed this plugin.
